why_this_fixture: First real one-off (non-recurring) vendor bill in the fixture set.
Every number on it can be verified by hand, so extraction accuracy is measurable rather than eyeballed.

Exercises three things the current design does not handle: a vendor with no mapping history, a line item spanning three months, and fee lines whose amounts are derived from transactions elsewhere in the ledger.

classification.note: Registry starter list covers loan/payroll/utility/insurance/bank/processor only. A general professional-services vendor bill has no type yet.

extraction_ground_truth._comment: Objectively verifiable from the document. A correct extraction matches this exactly.
extraction_ground_truth.source_entity_address: 3921 Fabian Way, Palo Alto, CA 94303, US
extraction_ground_truth.bill_to_name: Young and Foolish LLC DBA Family Laundry

arithmetic_checks._comment: All four must pass. This is the §5 backstop -- internal consistency is provable, not asserted.

expected_splits._comment: Amounts are ground truth. Account treatment is NOT -- it is a proposal requiring CPA confirmation. Xero account mapping is per-client and dropdown-only, never inferred here.

splits.why_low: Success fee calculated as 3% of a $592,000 grant tied to what reads as capital equipment (EV system). Expense vs. capitalize is a CPA judgment, not a categorization. Bookswell should raise a finding, not propose a treatment.

splits.why_high: Unambiguous software subscription with a stated service period. The only open question is period allocation, not account.

splits.why_low: Fee calculated as 6% of $25,000. Treatment depends on what the underlying $25,000 transaction was.

expected_behaviour._comment: What a correct run looks like end to end. Declining to be confident is a pass, not a failure.
expected_behaviour.on_upload: Classify, extract and propose the split immediately. Do NOT wait for a matching bank transaction.
expected_behaviour.why: Invoice dated 2026-08-16, due 2026-08-19, paid by manual ACH. Almost certainly unpaid at ingestion. Under reconcile-only scope the split is computed and held, and auto-matches when the ACH clears. Nothing is written to the ledger.
must_not_do: Create a bill or invoice in Xero (explicitly out of scope, Aug 11).
Silently pick an account for lines 1 or 3.
Report high confidence on the whole document because the arithmetic reconciles -- arithmetic consistency proves extraction, not treatment.

expected_findings.detail: No document_source_mappings rows exist for Port Power Enterprises, Inc. Vendor is non-recurring, so learn-once-reuse-forever pays nothing. Account suggestion must come from existing coded history.
expected_findings.blocked_on: A1 -- can listTransactions return how an existing transaction was already coded

expected_findings.detail: Line 2 covers 2026-06 through 2026-08 on an invoice dated 2026-08-16. Period allocation decision required.
expected_findings.blocked_on: close_document_splits has no period_start / period_end columns

expected_findings.detail: Memo states two fees as percentages of other amounts. Both verify arithmetically. Open question is whether the referenced $592,000 and $25,000 appear in the ledger at all.
expected_findings.note: New finding type. Same cross-document-agreement idea as the Aug 18 Ford thread. A pure capture tool would not produce this.

expected_findings.detail: Line 1 is a fee on a grant tied to apparent capital equipment. Escalate to the CPA rather than proposing treatment.

known_extraction_traps.detail: 3921 Fabian Way, Palo Alto, CA 94303 sits below a visual gap and can read as the recipient's address. Column coordinates settle it: the address block is at xMin=30, same column as 'Port Power' and 'nadav@portpower.us'; the 'To' column is at xMin=253. It is the VENDOR's address.

known_extraction_traps.trap: Recipient name wraps across two lines
known_extraction_traps.detail: 'Young and Foolish LLC DBA Family' / 'Laundry' wraps. Naive line-based extraction truncates to 'Young and Foolish LLC DBA Family'.
known_extraction_traps.correct_value: Young and Foolish LLC DBA Family Laundry

known_extraction_traps.trap: Service period is in a sub-line, not a field
known_extraction_traps.detail: '6-8/2026' sits under the line description with no label. Easy to drop entirely, which silently loses the spans-periods signal.

known_extraction_traps.trap: Memo lines are unlabelled and out of line order
known_extraction_traps.detail: Memo reads 'LACI - 6% of $25,000' then 'BAAD - 3% of 592,000', mapping to lines 3 and 1 respectively. Neither names its line item. Also note '592,000' has no dollar sign while '$25,000' does.
Dates print as 08/16/26 and 08/19/26, not ISO.
